facts.fact: ITWeb reports that ICASA, the communications regulator, published the IMT Roadmap 2026 and its draft implementation plans (draft spectrum assignment plans, feasibility studies, draft exclusive geographic areas for millimetre-wave bands) for public consultation, inviting interested stakeholders to submit written comments; the date is the article's publication date.

ICASA says the final National Radio Frequency Plan 2026 followed a public consultation that began on 4 April 2025, when it invited written submissions from stakeholders and members of the public on the first draft; the minister approved the final plan on 2 July 2026.

note: Two consultations stated (IMT Roadmap draft, NRFP 2026 draft); the legal duty to review the NRFP is a rule on review, not on consultation, and no published report of comments is stated.
